ihram.title: Entering the State of Ihram
ihram.desc: At the miqat boundary, perform ghusl, wear the ihram garments, make the intention (niyyah) and recite the Talbiyah. Certain restrictions begin once in ihram (no stitched clothing, perfume, etc.).

tawaf.title: Tawaf (Circling the Kaaba)
tawaf.desc: Starting from the Black Stone, circle the Kaaba seven times counter-clockwise, saluting the Black Stone at the start of each circuit if possible.

sayi.title: Sa'i (Between Safa and Marwah)
sayi.desc: Walk briskly seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah, commemorating Hajar's search for water.

halq.title: Shaving or Trimming Hair (Halq/Taqsir)
halq.desc: Men shave their heads completely or trim their hair; women cut a fingertip's length. This completes Umrah and ends the ihram restrictions.

arafat.title: Standing at Arafat (9th Dhul-Hijjah)
arafat.desc: The most essential pillar of Hajj. Pilgrims stand at Arafat from noon until sunset on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah, engaging in supplication, remembrance and repentance.

muzdalifah.title: Staying Overnight at Muzdalifah
muzdalifah.desc: After Arafat, pilgrims move to Muzdalifah, combine Maghrib and Isha prayers, spend the night there, and gather pebbles for the stoning ritual.

jamarat.title: Stoning the Jamarat
jamarat.desc: Pebbles are thrown at the Jamarat pillars in Mina on the designated days, commemorating Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) rejection of Satan.

qurban.title: Sacrifice (Qurbani)
qurban.desc: A sacrifice is offered as part of the Hajj rites, marking the start of Eid al-Adha.

farewell_tawaf.title: Farewell Tawaf
farewell_tawaf.desc: The final tawaf performed before leaving Mecca, marking the completion of the Hajj rites.
